messages:
Acme Billing: Hi team — our AP noticed the invoice we received is in USD but we need an official EUR invoice tied to our EU entity for VAT reclaim. Invoice INV-2025-789, Account acct_abc123, PO PO-78945. Paid on 2025-10-22. The EUR amount on our books (after FX) is off by €1.23 vs the USD charged. Can you reissue in EUR and include our VAT number? Accountant is asking for a local-currency invoice with the PO on it.
Emma - Finance: Sorry for the trouble. Quick Qs: did you receive an invoice PDF that says USD, or was the payment processed in USD? If payment captured we usually do a credit note + new invoice. Can you paste the invoice PDF link or screenshot and confirm VAT number?
Acme Billing: We got the PDF saying USD. Screenshot: https://acme.example.com/screenshots/inv-INV-2025-789.png VAT: DE123456789. Payment shows as "succeeded" in their portal but still need EUR invoice for tax reclaim.
billing-bot: Payment attempt logged: invoice=INV-2025-789 status=paid processor_status=succeeded processor_err_code=null attempt_ts=2025-10-22T14:12:08Z txn=txn_1JXYzA
Samir (CS): tagging @Alex P (Billing) — likely this is multi-entity routing: invoice created on global entity (USD) then charged via hub. Common repro: request invoice via EU entity path but fallback to global when customer default entity missing.
Emma - Finance: Can you share account id + the exact invoice id (we have it) and whether the customer asked for EU entity during signup? Also confirm PO wording to include on reissue.
Acme Billing: Account acct_abc123, invoice attached above, PO must be on the invoice as "PO: PO-78945" and billing address must show Germany address. They requested EU entity at signup but our platform may have defaulted to global.
Samir (CS): Repro steps for internal ops: 1) curl GET https://billing.redwood.com/v1/invoices/INV-2025-789 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBILL" 2) check invoice.entity and invoice.currency 3) check exchange_rates table for invoice.created_at window. Example:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBILL" \
  "https://billing.redwood.com/v1/invoices/INV-2025-789" | jq .
```
Alex P (Billing): Thanks. Preliminary root cause: invoice was generated under the global USD entity because account.secondary_entity was null; payment still captured via Stripe in USD. Options: (A) issue credit note for the USD invoice and create a new EUR invoice on EU entity (preferred), (B) manual amendment of invoice PDF (not ideal for VAT reclaim). We need finance approval for credit note/refund. Also must ensure PO text included.
Emma - Finance: Agree with (A). We need to confirm whether the payment can be refunded and recharged in EUR. If payment was captured more than 7 days ago we still can do a refund + new charge, but customer prefers a reissued invoice without refund if possible. For tax we must create a credit_note referencing original invoice id.
Alex P (Billing): Payment processor log shows txn_1JXYzA captured in USD. Refund flow: create credit_note referencing INV-2025-789 (amount USD), create new invoice in EUR under EU entity, link the PO and VAT number. Note FX rounding difference likely from nightly FX rate used during capture — see exchange_rates[2025-10-22]. Small cents are expected but we should surface narrative on invoice PDF: "Original amount USD X refunded; reissued EUR amount Y; rounding difference Z".
Acme Billing: We really want the final invoice file in EUR with PO line and VAT details. Can you confirm ETA? Our month-end is Friday.
Samir (CS): I'll open a payments escalation (P2) with the payments team and attach the txn id + logs. Ticket draft: "Reissue EUR invoice for acct_abc123, original USD invoice INV-2025-789, txn txn_1JXYzA. Request: credit_note + new invoice in EUR, include PO PO-78945 and VAT DE123456789. Account should be set to EU entity going forward." Will cc @Emma - Finance.
Emma - Finance: I'll prepare the credit note and queue the reissue. Two items I need from Acme: (1) confirmation that refund is acceptable if needed, (2) billing email for new invoice delivery. Also confirm whether they want a cash refund or just accounting credit.
Acme Billing: Refund is OK if needed. Send to billing@acme.com. Please include "PO: PO-78945" in invoice header. Thanks.
Alex P (Billing): Action items: - Samir: create payments ticket with txn and logs (started) - Emma: prepare credit_note and new EUR invoice draft - Alex: run reissue script once approved:
```bash
./scripts/reissue_invoice --invoice INV-2025-789 --to-entity eu --currency EUR --include-vat --po "PO-78945" --notify billing@acme.com
```
Emma - Finance: Targeting EOD Friday (2025-10-24) to have credit_note + new invoice issued. Will update ticket with final PDFs.
Acme Billing: Appreciate it. Please keep us posted — accountant will verify VAT reclaim once we have the EUR PDF. :thumbsup:
Emma - Finance: Noted. Samir, please escalate to payments and add this to Monday finance queue if not resolved by EOD.
Samir (CS): Escalation created: PAY-5421. Assigned to payments-team. I'll paste link once available.
billing-bot: Created support ticket PAY-5421 for invoice reissue request. Status: open.
Alex P (Billing): FYI, if we see repeated multi-entity misses we should add a validation on invoice creation to require entity when account.region == EU. I'll add a GH task after this case. :eyes:
Acme Billing: Thanks everyone — looking forward to the EUR invoice.
